description: Evidence-first dependency auditing: runs each ecosystem's real audit tooling (npm/pnpm/yarn audit, pip-audit, cargo audit, govulncheck, bundler-audit, composer audit, dotnet list package, osv-scanner) for CVEs, outdated packages, license obligations, and supply-chain signals, and reports only tool-verified facts under TOOL-REPORTED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN evidence tiers. Obligations-based license analysis instead of a compatibility matrix; strictly non-destructive remediation (plan and approval before any update, never npm audit fix --force). One command (/deps-audit) plus a knowledge-base skill with per-ecosystem, license, and supply-chain references.
name: dependency-audit
